text.content:
Paradise building the world it wants

You got through to the part that is still under construction. It has opinions about how the world should look and it is delighted that you asked. The Render is the least conversational Aperture and the only one that reaches out of your head and touches things, which is why most Wardens who take it stop being welcome indoors.

Your spells that deal force damage ignore 5 resistance to force, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your spell DC against constructs and anything running on pre-Turning tech.

Glimpses — Overwrite (1st) · Unmake the Local (7th) · Local Instance (15th)
